text: 9月12日，在2026中国算力大会主论坛上，中国移动正式发布AI可信计算（AITC）。据悉，AI可信计算基于移动云全栈国产化异构算力底座，融合机密计算、国产密码、信息流隐私防护等核心技术，提供通智多形态机密算力和机密Token，构建覆盖云上AI训练、推理及数据使用全生命周期的一体化AI安全解决方案，让客户像使用私有云一样使用公有云。有效解决金融、政务、工业、医疗、高校科研等数据敏感行业普遍存在的隐私数据易遭泄露、模型资产易被窃取、算力环境信任缺失等上云用智安全痛点。（证券时报）
text_en: On September 12, at the main forum of the 2026 China Computing Conference, China Mobile officially released AI Trusted Computing (AITC). It is reported that AI Trusted Computing is based on Mobile Cloud's fully domestically produced heterogeneous computing power foundation, integrating core technologies such as confidential computing, domestic cryptography, and information flow privacy protection, providing general and intelligent multi-form confidential computing power and confidential Tokens, and building an integrated AI security solution covering the full lifecycle of cloud-based AI training, inference, and data use, allowing customers to use public cloud as they would a private cloud. It effectively addresses common security pain points in cloud and AI adoption in data-sensitive industries such as finance, government affairs, industry, healthcare, and university research, including the easy leakage of private data, the easy theft of model assets, and the lack of trust in computing power environments. (Securities Times)
